subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report access — NDA signer & bridge letter window
content:
From: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@finpartners.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: auditops+fp@finpartners.com
Date: Tue, 22 Sep 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II report access — NDA and bridge letter

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for taking this on. Our procurement team needs two things before we can accept access to Redwood's SOC 2 Type II artifacts: 1) a countersigned NDA listing the legal entity that will hold the data (we typically require the vendor signatory name and an exec-level signer), and 2) a bridge letter that explicitly states the audit period covered. For this engagement we need the bridge letter to confirm coverage through 2026-06-30.

Can you confirm who at Redwood will be signing the NDA (full legal name to appear on the document) and whether the bridge letter will use the standard CISO signature or require your legal counsel? Also, procurement asks whether the bridge letter expiry will be 90 days from signature or linked to the audit report date — please state which you intend.

We can accept a scanned countersigned PDF by email or a DocuSign link. If you prefer a secure drive transfer after NDA, tell us and we’ll provide the secure workspace.

Procurement reference: FP-2026-2119

Thanks,
Sarah Lim
Senior Procurement Manager 
FinPartners

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@finpartners.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report access — NDA and bridge letter

Sarah — thanks for the clear checklist. Short answers up front:
- Signatory name: "Redwood Inference, Inc." (please use this exact legal name on the NDA).
- Signer: Marcus Lin (VP Legal) can countersign for us; I’ll loop him in.
- Bridge letter: we generally provide a CISO-signed bridge letter that states the audit period and the report date, with an explicit expiry 90 days from issuance unless you require otherwise. For this request we can confirm coverage through 2026-06-30.

Proposed workflow:
1) Marcus will countersign the NDA and return a scanned PDF (or DocuSign if you prefer).
2) Once NDA executed, we will upload the SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter to a secure Google Drive folder and share access to the FinPartners procurement group.
3) If you need any redactions (privileged sections), please flag them up front so Legal can review before release.

Marcus / Olga — can you confirm you’re good to sign and whether Legal wants any custom retention language in the NDA (FinPartners asked about data retention and deletion timelines in the request form).

—Jordan
Director, Commercial
Redwood Inference

Hi all — I reviewed FinPartners’ request. I can countersign the NDA as VP Legal. A few notes for the NDA and bridge letter to avoid delays: 

- Please list the signatory as "Redwood Inference, Inc." and the signer's name as Marcus Lin, VP Legal.
- We prefer to use the standard Redwood NDA with a one-year retention/deletion clause for audit artifacts; if FinPartners requires a different retention window, we need that spelled out so we can add it.
- For the bridge letter, we'll include the audit window (2025-07-01 through 2026-06-30) and the issuance date; our standard practice is to state the bridge letter expires 90 days after issuance. If FinPartners wants expiry tied to report date instead, please confirm.

I've attached a redline-ready draft of the NDA (Draft_NDA_Redwood_v1.docx) and an editable bridge letter template (SOC2_TypeII_Bridge_Letter_Template.pdf). Once FinPartners confirms the signatory name and retention window, I’ll countersign in DocuSign and upload the signed PDF.

Marcus Lin
